verdict.rationale: Docs directly describe provisioning a GPU Pod from console or CLI/API within minutes, with templates preconfigured (PyTorch/JupyterLab) and immediate SSH/JupyterLab/VSCode/web access to run code (runpod-docs-1,10,14,29,43,46,52). Community evidence corroborates ease of quick deployment via templates (runpod-comm-5) and GPU access advantages (runpod-comm-1), though notes intermittent low availability issues (runpod-comm-4) and a locked-down execution environment for some SSH-tunneling use cases (runpod-comm-2,3) that are secondary/edge-case concerns not core to the story. missing for 10: independent hands-on timing benchmarks confirming 'minutes' claim, and no resolution of the availability/lockdown caveats.
